name: Natsuki Miyuri
source:
"It's alright now... Onee-chan has come to pick you up..."

Akito's sister-in-law, and the woman he is in love with. A perfect housewife who boasts a gorgeous body as well as superb cooking and housework skills.  She dotes on Akito so much, and was excited with their life as a family of three after her marriage with Kazuto, but she was saddened because it became a dream which can never be realized.

[Translated from [url=http://www.alicesoft.com/tsumamigui3/chara/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
